List, get, and download versions of a SharePoint item

Source: R/sp_item_versions.R
list_sp_item_versions.Rd

list_sp_item_versions() lists the versions of a SharePoint file (a driveItem) and when and by whom they were saved, which makes it possible to check the recent edit history of a file such as an Excel workbook. get_sp_item_version() returns a single version, and download_sp_item_version() saves the content of a past version of the file.

Usage

list_sp_item_versions(
  ...,
  sp_item = NULL,
  n = NULL,
  modified_between = NULL,
  item_cols = c("id", "none", "summary"),
  version_cols = c("properties", "all"),
  as_data_frame = TRUE,
  call = caller_env()
)

get_sp_item_version(
  version_id,
  ...,
  sp_item = NULL,
  item_cols = c("id", "none", "summary"),
  version_cols = c("properties", "all"),
  as_data_frame = TRUE,
  call = caller_env()
)

download_sp_item_version(
  version_id,
  ...,
  sp_item = NULL,
  dest = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  call = caller_env()
)

Arguments

...

Arguments passed on to get_sp_item

path

A SharePoint file URL or the relative path to a file located in a SharePoint drive. If input is a relative path, the string should not include the drive name. If input is a shared file URL, the text "Shared " is removed from the start of the SharePoint drive name by default. If file is a document URL, the default_drive_name argument is used as the drive_name and the item_id is extracted from the URL.

item_id

A SharePoint item ID passed to the itemid parameter of the get_item method for ms_drive objects.

item_url

A SharePoint item URL used to parse the item ID, drive name, and site URL.

drive_name,drive_id

SharePoint drive name or ID.

drive

A ms_drive object. If drive is supplied, drive_name, site_url, and any additional parameters passed to ... are ignored.

properties

If TRUE, use the get_item_properties method and return item properties instead of the item.

site_url

A SharePoint site URL in the format "https://[tenant name].sharepoint.com/sites/[site name]". Any SharePoint item or document URL can also be parsed to build a site URL using the tenant and site name included in the URL.

sp_item

A ms_drive_item object for a SharePoint file. Additional parameters passed to ... are ignored if sp_item is supplied.

n

Maximum number of versions to return, starting with the newest (latest). Defaults to NULL (all versions). Applied after modified_between.

modified_between

A length 2 vector of dates or date-times with the start and end of the period to return versions for (inclusive, as in dplyr::between()). Use NA for an open start or end. A Date end includes that whole day. Character values are parsed as UTC. If the lubridate package is installed, a lubridate::interval() is also accepted.

item_cols

Item columns to add to the returned data frame: "id" (default) adds item_id and drive_id, "summary" also adds item_name and item_web_url, and "none" adds no item columns.

version_cols

Version columns to return: "properties" (default) returns version_id, version, last_modified, last_modified_by, last_modified_by_email, last_modified_by_id, and size and "all" also returns everything else the API provides, including download_url. The download URL includes a short-lived access token so is not returned by default. Column names use snake case (unlike the Graph API property names that sp_dir_info() returns).

as_data_frame

If TRUE (default), return a data frame. If FALSE, return the response from the API as a list.

call

The execution environment of a currently running function, e.g. caller_env(). The function will be mentioned in error messages as the source of the error. See the call argument of abort() for more information.

version_id

Version ID, e.g. "3.0", as returned by list_sp_item_versions().

dest

Path to save the file to. Defaults to the name of the item with the version ID added before the file extension (e.g. "book_v3.0.xlsx") in the working directory.

overwrite

If TRUE, overwrite an existing file at dest.

Value

For list_sp_item_versions(), a data frame with one row for each version (newest first) if as_data_frame = TRUE or a list with the versions in value otherwise. For get_sp_item_version(), a one row data frame or a list. For download_sp_item_version(), the path to the downloaded file (invisibly).

Details

These functions use the do_operation method for a ms_drive_item object directly. The intent is to add comparable methods back to the Microsoft365R package which may include changes to the functionality and output of these functions.

Versions are only available if versioning is enabled for the document library (the default for SharePoint). The Graph API doesn't document the order it returns versions in. In testing with 60 files, it always returned versions from newest to oldest, so n is sent to the API as $top to limit the size of the response for files with many versions and returns the newest versions. The versions that are returned are sorted by last modified time. The API does not support filtering versions by date, so if modified_between is used, all versions are requested and n is applied afterward. SharePoint may combine edits made close together into a single version.

Version IDs

Version IDs (e.g. "3.0") are only unique within a single item. Use item_cols = "id" (the default) to keep the item ID alongside the version ID if you combine the results for more than one item.

See the Microsoft Graph documentation for listing versions and the driveItemVersion resource.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# List the five most recent versions of a file
list_sp_item_versions(item_url = "<SharePoint file URL>", n = 5)

# Versions saved in October 2026
list_sp_item_versions(
  item_url = "<SharePoint file URL>",
  modified_between = c("2026-10-01", "2026-10-31")
)
} # }
